newsitem.title: USA: Substance Abuse Tech names new pres, COO.
newsitem.headline: Substance Abuse Tech names new pres, COO.

text.p: Substance Abuse Technologies Inc said on Wednesday that it had appointed David Dorff as its new president and chief operating officer.

Dorff replaces Linda Masterson as president of the company, SAU said in a statement. Masterson resigned to accept an appointement as chief executive officer and president of U.S. Drug Testing Inc, a majority owned subsidiary of SAU.
Most recently, Dorff served a two-year term as senior vice president and chief finacial officer fo the Triarc Restaurant Group, a chain that includes Arby's and T.J. Cinnamon's, SAU said.
Substance Abuse Technologies offers customized loss-prevention and risk-managment services, with special emphasis on workplace substance-abuse.
